programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
        if len(marks) < 2:
            continue
        mark_color = grid[r][marks[0]]
        fill_color = mark_color + 1
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                if grid[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = fill_color
    return out
'''
